page.notes: The underlined numbers in the printed index (such as 336, 600, 603) are copied as plain digits. Long s has been normalised to s throughout, so "terreftria", "balfamo", "aftate", "vifcera" and similar forms read as terrestria, balsamo, astate, viscera. Corrected long s to plain s throughout (fuppofita, fatione, fcholis, admisit, Vafi). Where the entry reads "impactus", the scan is unclear and that word is uncertain. "34r" in the number of the Vectium entry is read as 341 and is marked [?]. Entries with "fol-vitur" and "jux-ta" keep their printed hyphens at the line end.
